steps.title: Prepare hybridization equipment
steps.instruction: Turn on the hybridization oven to 65 °C; turn on a heat block to 95 °C; turn on a second heat block to 37 °C.

steps.title: Mix Cy3 and Cy5 samples
steps.instruction: Combine the Cy3‑ and Cy5‑labeled samples as described in the labeling protocol.

steps.title: Prepare hybridization mixture
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube add 39 µL Cy3/Cy5 gDNA mixture, 5 µL Cot‑1 DNA (1.3 µg/µL), 11 µL Agilent 10× blocking agent, and 55 µL Agilent 2× Hybridization buffer, for a total volume of 110 µL.

steps.title: Mix hybridization mixture
steps.instruction: Pipette up and down gently to mix, taking care not to create bubbles.

steps.title: Centrifuge mixture briefly
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at maximum speed for a few seconds.

steps.title: Denature and pre‑incubate
steps.instruction: Heat the tube at 95 °C for 3 minutes, then immediately incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Leave the samples in the heat block, then spin at maximum speed for 1 minute.

steps.title: Load mixture onto gasket
steps.instruction: Place the gasket slide in the hybridization chamber and dispense 100 µL of the hybridization mixture using a 200 µL pipette, avoiding bubble formation.

steps.title: Assemble hybridization chamber
steps.instruction: Place the microarray slide with the active side down onto the gasket and assemble the chamber.

steps.title: Remove air bubbles
steps.instruction: Rotate the assembled chamber to check for immobile bubbles; if bubbles are present, tap or slam the side of the chamber on the table to release them.

steps.title: Load chamber into oven
steps.instruction: Insert the assembled chamber into the hybridization oven set to 65 °C with shaking at 20 rpm, balancing it with empty chambers.

steps.title: Hybridization incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 24 hours at 65 °C with shaking at 20 rpm.

steps.title: Power on slide scanner
steps.instruction: Turn on the Agilent Slide Scanner.

steps.title: Prepare wash dishes
steps.instruction: Rinse the wash‑buffer dishes with distilled water and dry them using pressurized air.

steps.title: Separate slides in buffer 1
steps.instruction: In dish #1 containing buffer 1, separate the gasket slide from the microarray slide.

steps.title: Wash slides in buffer 2
steps.instruction: Place the slides in a holding rack and immerse them in dish #2 (buffer 2) for 5 minutes with the stirrer rotating.

steps.title: Confirm scanner settings
steps.instruction: In the scanner software, click “Set Values” to confirm all parameters.

steps.title: Wash slides in buffer 3
steps.instruction: Transfer the holding rack to dish #3 (buffer 2) and wash for 1 minute with both stirrer rotation and heating turned on.

steps.title: Acetonitrile wash
steps.instruction: Move the holding rack to dish #4 containing acetonitrile and incubate for 1 minute.

steps.title: Remove slide carefully
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, gently lift the slide to prevent droplet formation.

steps.title: Load slide into scanner
steps.instruction: Place the slide in a holder, load it into the scanner carousel, ensuring the back (barcode side) faces the scanner.

steps.title: Run feature extraction
steps.instruction: Open the “feature extraction” module and verify the generated TIFF file.

steps.title: Start scanning slots
steps.instruction: In the Scan Control main window, click “Scan Slot m‑n”, where m is the start slot and n is the end slot for the slides to be scanned.
